description: Cyclone Energy Group describes applying IESVE to building models since 2012. The case covers geometry preparation in ModelIT, export to CBECC-Com for California compliance work, HVAC controls and plant simulation in ApacheHVAC, daylight analysis and airflow studies. Examples include a chiller-plant temperature study and airflow around office air intakes. The provider reports experience with 400 to 500 models at the time of the account. The portfolio total is a dated provider claim, not an enumerated public collection of project files. This public HTML case narrative is published by IES and can be read without payment. Its reuse licence is not stated. Access to the described software, input data and project models is not established by the public page. The source does not give a complete study period or all spatial and temporal model resolutions. Reported results are provider claims and have not been independently reproduced. The case supports the documented infrastructure simulation use and is linked to the named modelling resources. Only metadata and the case description were inspected; no data or model files were downloaded.
